availability_evidence: Annual report pages 52 and 89 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board and authorised for issue on 18 March 2020; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Recycled-paper pricing pressured Datashred and selected businesses incurred planned ramp-up costs, but Group revenue rose 10%, adjusted profit before tax 13%, operating margin 40 basis points and earnings per share 9.5%. Strong cash generation reduced leverage from 2.1x to 1.6x and supported a 20% dividend increase.
already_announced_exclusion: The Beckton and Nottingham site exits, property-estate review, Portsmouth-related integration work and other operational changes already completed or disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Localised pricing pressure is outweighed by broad revenue, profit, margin and cash improvement with material deleveraging and recurring revenues.

availability_evidence: Annual report pages 69 and 101 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board and authorised for issue on 16 March 2022; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 28%, adjusted profit before tax 64% and earnings per share 55% as organic recovery and eight acquisitions expanded the Group. Some pandemic headwinds remained and net debt increased with acquisition investment, but leverage stayed at 1.8x, cash conversion was 85%, liquidity headroom was substantial and the dividend resumed.
already_announced_exclusion: The eight completed acquisitions, their integration and restructuring costs, fuel-supplier consolidation and announced property consolidation activity are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Residual operating headwinds and acquisition-funded debt are visible, but record revenue and profit, strong cash conversion, stable leverage and substantial funding capacity provide strong contrary evidence.

availability_evidence: Annual report pages 82 and 123 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board and authorised for issue on 13 March 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Industry-specific headwinds left revenue broadly flat, reduced adjusted operating profit 15% and adjusted profit before tax 26%, and drove a £29.0m statutory loss including £36.3m of impairments. Management, head-office, property and business restructurings were already underway. Cash conversion improved to 110%, free cash flow rose and net debt fell, although leverage increased to 1.9x.
already_announced_exclusion: The head-office reduction, Technology and Datashred management changes, business right-sizing, Technology exit, property-estate review and site consolidations disclosed or undertaken before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: The broad profit deterioration, impairments and multiple operational headwinds indicate high pressure, partly offset by strong cash conversion, deleveraging, contracted income and covenant headroom.
